title: Measures to Improve Road Safety Given Pedestrian Fatalities amongst Seniors
what_it_is: Measures to Improve Road Safety Given Pedestrian Fatalities amongst Seniors

sections.label: Elderly road safety measures
sections.summary: TP partners centres and Lion Befrienders to educate elderly on road safety, launched an Eye Care Kit, and MHA will enhance enforcement against motorists in Silver Zones.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: TP partners Senior Activity Centres and Lion Befrienders to educate the elderly on road safety.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: It launched the Eye Care Kit in February 2021, which allows elderly pedestrians to make a self-assessment on their eye health and encourages them to seek early intervention to address any issues.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As mentioned in MHA's Committee of Supply debate, MHA will be enhancing enforcement against irresponsible motorists in Silver Zones.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Motorists who commit offences at Silver Zones, such as speeding or using mobile communicative devices while driving, will incur two additional demerit points on top of the usual demerit points for their offence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They will also be liable for an additional $100 in composition fine.
